# Isaiah Chapter 63 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 19 verses]*

*Warrior from Edom; garments stained; day of vengeance; steadfast love recalled; where is God? You are our Father*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** I have trodden the winepress alone, and from the peoples no one was with me. This chapter warrior from edom.

*-- LOGOS*
